title: Xoom 160 Adventure Scooter Concept (Track Edition)
description: Representing Hero MotoCorp's prowess in the Commuter Scooter class, the Hero MotoCorp Xoom 160 Adventure Scooter Concept (Track Edition) is tuned for uncompromising circuit performance with laser-guided cornering stability. A 160cc powerplant pumps out 16 HP and 13 Nm of torque, striking an optimal balance between fuel economy and spirited passing power. With an accessible 765mm seat height that allows easy flat-footing for virtually all rider heights and a comfortable Step-Through Upright layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
